class.name: NetwSpawnRecord
class.brief_description: One armed or issued spawn: the identity a verb stamped, the recipe a receiver rebuilds from, and the peers the frame went to.
class.description: Every object this record names is held as an id and resolved at each use, so a record never keeps a node alive and a node freed while armed reads as absent rather than as a dangling instance. Orphan ownership therefore stays with the caller that armed it. The recipient set is reached through verbs rather than as an array, because it is the book a despawn is addressed from: a caller that mutated a copy would send the frame to a set nothing recorded. [codeblock] record.bind_node(node) the node, while it lives record.add_recipient(peer) the spawn frame reached one more peer record.has_recipient(peer) and the despawn is owed to it [/codeblock] [member recipe] is one of [enum NetwSpawnBook.Recipe], and the book this record is armed in is [NetwSpawnBook].

method.name: add_recipient
method.description: Records that this spawn reached [param peer], and answers whether that is new. A peer already in the book is not enrolled twice.

method.name: bind_fn_host
method.description: Names the object a [code]FN[/code] recipe calls its method on. Passing [code]null[/code] forgets it.

method.name: bind_node
method.description: Names the node this record was stamped for. Passing [code]null[/code] forgets it.

method.name: bind_spawner
method.description: Names the spawner a [code]SPAWNER[/code] recipe was consumed from. Passing [code]null[/code] forgets it.

method.name: fn_host
method.description: The object a [code]FN[/code] recipe calls its method on, or [code]null[/code] once it is gone.

method.name: has_recipient
method.description: Whether this spawn reached [param peer], which is also whether its despawn is owed to it.

method.name: node
method.description: The node this record was stamped for, or [code]null[/code] once it is gone.

method.name: recipients
method.description: The peers this spawn reached, in the order they were enrolled. It is a copy, so a caller that means to change the book calls [method add_recipient] or [method remove_recipient].

method.name: remove_recipient
method.description: Drops [param peer] from the book and answers whether it was there.

method.name: set_recipients
method.description: Replaces the whole book with [param peers], keeping no duplicate.

method.name: spawner
method.description: The spawner a [code]SPAWNER[/code] recipe was consumed from, or [code]null[/code] once it is gone.
